guide.title: Call Recording Guide
guide.subtitle: Learn how to safely record suspicious calls in accordance with legal norms in Togo.
guide.legalNotice: Legal & Ethical Framework: Only record calls when you suspect fraud to protect yourself. CyberSafe never records anything without your explicit action.
androidSteps: Check if your official Phone app includes a 'Record' button during an active call.
If not available, put the call on speaker and use the voice recorder of another device.
Avoid installing untrusted third-party apps demanding dangerous permissions.
iosSteps: On iOS 18.1+, tap the call recording icon in the top-left during your phone call.
Alternatively, use speakerphone and record with the Voice Memos app on another tablet or phone.
Export the resulting audio file to analyze it in CyberSafe Online.
guide.whatNextDesc: Hang up immediately if the caller demands your PIN or makes threats. Import the audio file or write the summary into our scanner.

about.title: About CyberSafe Online
about.subtitle: An inclusive anti-fraud digital security platform for Togo.
about.missionDesc: CyberSafe Online protects Togolese citizens against pervasive financial fraud targeting T-Money, Moov Money, and digital payment systems.
about.multilingualDesc: In full alignment with the CyberSafe Online specification, the platform natively supports French, English, and Éwé (Eʋegbe). The CyberSafe AI analysis engine is calibrated for local linguistic nuances, including code-switching and indigenous terms.
about.safetyDesc: No passive listening or background recording. Submitted content is processed to provide the requested analysis; extracted URLs may be sent to VirusTotal when enabled. Never submit a PIN or OTP code.
